endorsements.name: Lukasz Plonka
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-5444
endorsements.description: A Cross Site Request Forgery vulnerability in ePolicy Orchestrator prior to 5.10.0 CP1 Update 2 allows a remote low privilege user to successfully add a new user with administrator privileges to the ePO server. This impacts the dashboard area of the user interface. To exploit this the attacker must change the HTTP payload post submission, prior to it reaching the ePO server.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Lukasz Plonka
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-5445
endorsements.description: An open redirect vulnerability in ePolicy Orchestrator prior to 5.10.0 CP1 Update 2, allows a remote low privileged user to modify the URL parameter for the purpose of redirecting URL request(s) to a malicious site. This impacts the dashboard area of the user interface. A user would need to be logged into ePO to trigger this vulnerability. To exploit this the attacker must change the HTTP payload post submission, prior to it reaching the ePO server.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.4)

endorsements.description:

This vulnerability is due to an incomplete fix for  CVE-2024-31156 https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000138636 . 

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
